control_failures.control_label: availability and testing of fixed fire protection
alarm, muster and accounting for people

facts.title: energy isolation failure on PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control MUSTER_AND_ACCOUNTING: the alarm, muster and accounting for people was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the alarm, muster and accounting for people on PSV-8201 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically alarming, mustering and accounting for people. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the availability and testing of fixed fire protection had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 January 2018 an incident occurred on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
